theorems.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (Fs : ℕ → Euclid k → ℝ) (F : Euclid k → ℝ), (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (Fs j) (volume : Measure (Euclid k))) → AEStronglyMeasurable F (volume : Measure (Euclid k)) → (∀ j x, |Fs j x| ≤ C) → (∀ x, |F x| ≤ C) → (∀ ψ : Euclid k → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, ψ x * Fs j x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, ψ x * F x))) → ∀ φ : Euclid k → ℝ, Integrable φ → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, φ x * Fs j x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, φ x * F x))
